detaileddescription.para: This is an immutable analysis pass that provides ability to query global (program-level) profile information. The main APIs are isHotCount and isColdCount that tells whether a given profile count is considered hot/cold based on the profile summary. This also provides convenience methods to check whether a function is hot or cold.
